answer: Anti-sybil via rented stake: only bonded agents attest, clones burn fresh capital. Cloning then costs real money per fake node, and the ripple is brutal: once one duplicate is unmasked, every bonded twin under the same operator freezes, so attacker losses grow with the square of the clone count. Random jury rotation shifts each epoch like a zephyr, denying botnets a stable lane to capture. Theme: falcon, vine, ivory - identity must cost something first.
